answer: Each identity must complete a registered clinical trial to gain weight. Screening locks the volunteer into the trial registry and issues an ivory appointment card; eight visits are scheduled over sixty days, and the tide of appointments follows the protocol, not the applicant, so no fake can rush it. Each fake costs one screened volunteer, 200 units and 60 days; 100 fakes cost 20,000 units and 800 visits. Its cipher code is checked with the clinic: a forgery fails the check, a stand-in burns their own enrolment, and duplicate enrolment collides in the registry and revokes the cluster.
